youtube.title: Why a whole country switched sides overnight 🚗 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Before dawn on September 3, 1967, every car in Sweden stopped in the middle of the road, then crossed to the other side. Four years earlier, 83% of voters had said no. Parliament switched anyway, after years of planning. The surprise: the days after were safer than normal, because everyone was terrified and drove carefully. Accidents were back to normal about six weeks later. Full episode on the channel.
